## What / Quoi

Describe the focused change and link any related issue.

## Why / Pourquoi

Explain the problem and the expected user or maintainer benefit.

## Verification / Vérification

List commands actually run, their results, and manual checks. State what was not tested.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (or failures are explained below).
- [ ] Relevant regression tests were added/updated, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in FR/EN and on relevant screen sizes; anonymized screenshots attached if useful.
- [ ] Documentation and wiki sources were updated when needed.

## Risks / Risques

Data migrations, compatibility, performance, security, generated assets and rollback, if applicable.

## Provenance

- [ ] No secrets, real classroom data, production exports or private logs are included.
- [ ] I have the rights to contribute this change under the applicable license; third-party assets retain their notices.
- [ ] Any substantial AI assistance is disclosed below; I understand and have reviewed the resulting changes.

AI assistance and new asset/dependency sources, if any:
